name: mirage
text: On your question why the engine priced far more RFQs earlier: I found the likely cause. Every time the engine restarts (about 12 times since 6 am: our deploys, plus its normal 5h40 handover) its fair-odds list starts empty and takes 10-15 minutes of scans to refill. Right after a restart it prices 0%; warm it prices 13-19% (the 17-out-of-60,000 reading is from a cold moment, like now: new job 3 min old). The sockets and APIs are fine. I'm building a fix so the fair odds carry over between restarts, and I'm asking the other session to batch deploys so it isn't restarted every hour.
